title: Rav Huna bar Chalvan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Shabbat 139b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.139b.8) the Rabbis said to Rav Ashi: “Let the Master see this Torah scholar — Rav Huna bar Rabbi Chiyun is his name, and some say Rav Huna bar Rabbi Chalvan is his name — who took a clove of garlic,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Shabbat gives the names with the father’s title Rabbi.

The linked Bavli gives both father-names. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=968&lang=en) also records Chiyun and Chalvan here. [Rashi’s gloss](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Shabbat.139b.8.1) explains ברא דתומא as a clove of garlic.
